title: Learning about MutantMania
description: Learning about MutantMania — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Loremaster Vraile

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Speak with the Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Loremaster Vraile

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Exploring Upper MutantMania

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Speak with the Loremaster Vraile in Townston.

Offer:

They say that some of the best collectables can be found in the MutantMania dungeon! And here I am--stuck all day on these steps, giving out quests to noobs!

Thinking back, Loremaster Vraile was the one who first tipped me off about the MutantMania. He seemed to know quite a few details about it, although I'm not sure why he would be so familiar with any underground sport.

If I were you, I would go to Loremaster Vraile and learn what evils may exist in that evil area of evil.

Turn-in:

Greetings, Dungeon Runner. How may I educate you, this fine day?

Level range: 80–100
